blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Melquiades “Mel” A. Robles, general manager of the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO), was promoted from auxiliary commodore to rear admiral of the Philippine Coast Guard Auxiliary (PCGA) during a ceremony at the Philippine Coast Guard Headquarters on Monday, Oct. 5. Robles described the promotion as an opportunity to strengthen his commitment to public service. “For me, public service is about being present when people need help. It is about finding ways to respond to their needs and making sure that the assistance reaches those who need it,” he said. READ: PCSO GM Mel Robles gets PCG Auxiliary Merit […]...
